name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is an early-stage gold-focused natural resource company operating exclusively in Nevada through a three-pronged model: royalty interest acquisitions, precious metal stream management, and an exploration project accelerator. The company holds a 3% Net Smelter Royalty and an Exploration Stream Earn-in Agreement on the Lapon Canyon Gold Project in Nevada. Recent drilling at Lapon Canyon has returned significant high-grade intercepts, including 6.81 g/t Au over 7.6 metres.
